comment: Evidence instrumentation for the translated runtime, applied by tools/xrt/xlift.py at lift time.
A mark records an ordered event (global sequence number, guest thread, optional register value) each time
execution reaches that instruction; the first occurrences go into the runtime report's event timeline and every
occurrence is counted. A watch records every store the translated code makes to a fixed global through a
constant address (value before/after, thread, site); the runtime also checks the value at every import call
and reports a change that no instrumented store explains.
Marks and watches only observe: they never change guest state. Entries are chosen from the original modules'
exports and from disassembly of the measured paths (addresses are for the SHA-256-checked originals).

marks.name: UCC main
marks.note: called by mainCRTStartup at 0x407cc3 with argc/argv/envp

marks.name: UCC main returned
marks.note: instruction after the call to main in mainCRTStartup; eax = main's return value, passed to exit()

marks.name: FFileStream worker thread entry
marks.note: thread procedure passed to CreateThread by FFileStream::Init; polls FFileStream::Destroyed

marks.name: FFileStream::Destroy
marks.note: sets Destroyed=1, then 'while (Destroyed == 1) appSleep(1.0)' until the worker acknowledges with 2

marks.name: FFileStream::Destroy: shutdown wait finished
marks.note: first instruction after the wait loop (reached from 0x1013daf0 or by leaving the loop at 0x1013db06)
